description: Full docs for one component by name or alias, in the project's framework: import, tag, setup, what it replaces, usage rules and example.

framework.description: The project's UI framework (from its package.json: @angular/core → angular, vue → vue, svelte → svelte, solid-js → solid, react → react). Defaults to the one set for this connection.

name.description: Component name, e.g. "Button" or an alias like "Modal"

name: get_component_docs
title: Get component docs
